name: PHP Syntax Color Highlighter
description:
Plugin allows to manage colors and styles of PHP keywords.

Open Settings
- Editor Tab 
- Color Scheme 
- PHP Colors

Then you can set custom styles to a keywords in a list.
Enjoy.

Getting started

Go to (Settings -> Editor -> Color Scheme -> Php Colors) to change the keywords to your preference.
notes:
Added

  • PHP 8 Functions
  • Date functions
  • Function return types
  • Debug keywords (print_r, console, debug)
  • PHPDoc keywords
